body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Eyemax presented its portable wireless LCD DVR 'EMW-LCD4' during KES 2007, which can connect with up to four cameras. By adopting 4GB SD memory card, it offers eight hours of recording time. Measuring 120 x 70 x 25(mm) at 170g, it is available for 290,000(KRW).
